title: 第2417章 都是苏锦的计划第2416章 进入遗迹
content_zh:
在这妖艳女人出现时，苏锦立刻发出了提醒。
不过，还是稍晚了一步。
灵衍神殿的众人看到这个女人的眼睛后，除了少数几人外，其他人无论男女，皆是受到了影响，满脸痴迷之色。
魅惑之术，一种影响人情绪的能力。
凡人有七情六欲，神灵亦不例外。
寻常魅惑难以动摇神明道心，可神域存有专门针对主神神魂的高阶魅惑术。
“攻击苏锦。”
魅惑女子认识苏锦，张开红唇对众人下达命令。
苏锦见众人中招，立刻弹奏古筝，骨节分明的玉手弹出神音，去帮众人削弱对方的魅惑之术。
几个魂系魂力强大的人，率先反应过来。
但还是有一名体修受到了影响，抬起拳头对着苏锦打了过去。
苏锦拇指与中指捏住一根琴弦，用力一拉，而后松开。
“铮！”
琴弦音波打在这名体修身上，这名体修胸口撕裂出一道口子，身体向着妖艳女人的方向倒飞出去。
岳天擎看着被轰飞的体修，忍不住骂道：
“也不知道殿主大人为何派这种废物来执行任务，一点意志力都没有，有着苏锦道友的帮助，居然还挡不住魅惑。”
这名被轰飞的体修，正是江平安。
同属于星辉城的郑赤焰，看到江平安没有挡住敌人的魅惑，都忍不住害臊，为此感到丢人。
他也没想到江平安的意志力这么薄弱，居然这么轻易就被控制了。
“砰！”

江平安撞在了一个被冰冻的建筑上。
楚媚烟见到这个人的意志力如此不坚定，立刻加大调动魂力，对其进行魅惑。
“小哥哥，来，帮姐姐对付这群人坏蛋，回头姐姐会好好奖励你哦。”
“楚媚烟！
你的胆子还真大，一个人就敢来拦截我们。”
苏锦清冷的呵斥声响起，同时拨弄手中的琴弦，释放音波对楚媚烟进行攻击。
楚媚烟抬手祭出一盏紫纹神灯，幽幽紫光四下铺展，一层无形屏障当诛了苏锦的音波攻势。
“咯咯。”
楚媚烟笑起来充满了诱惑，让人心脏狂跳，“杀了你们是不可能的，我也不想杀你们，但是，我必须拦住你们。”
紫光突然大亮，形成了一个紫色结界，将灵衍神殿众人笼罩。
她手中的灯，是一件高阶神器，不仅能防御，还能释放结界。
content_en:
When this charming woman appeared, Su Jin immediately issued a reminder.
However, it was still a little late.
After everyone in the Lingyan Temple saw this woman's eyes, except for a few people, everyone, both men and women, were affected and had a look of obsession on their faces.
The art of charm is the ability to influence people's emotions.
Mortals have seven emotions and six desires, and gods are no exception.
Ordinary charms cannot shake the gods' Taoist hearts, but there are high-level charm techniques specifically targeted at the souls of the main gods in the divine realm.
"Attack Su Jin."
The charming woman recognized Su Jin and opened her red lips to give orders to everyone.
When Su Jin saw that everyone was being tricked, he immediately played the guzheng, and his jade hands with clear joints played divine sounds to help everyone weaken the opponent's charm.
A few people with strong soul power were the first to react.
But one of the physical cultivators was still affected and raised his fist to hit Su Jin.
Su Jin pinched a string with his thumb and middle finger, pulled hard, and then released it.
"Zheng!"
The sound wave of the strings hit the body of the body cultivator, who tore a hole in his chest and flew backwards in the direction of the seductive woman.
Yue Tianqing looked at the body cultivators who were blown away and couldn't help but curse:
"I don't know why the Lord of the Palace sent this kind of waste to perform the task. He has no willpower at all. With the help of fellow Taoist Su Jin, he still can't stop the charm."
The body cultivator who was blown away was Jiang Ping'an.
Zheng Chiyan, who also belonged to Xinghui City, couldn't help but feel ashamed when he saw Jiang Pingan not blocking the enemy's charm.
He also didn't expect that Jiang Ping'an's willpower was so weak that he could be controlled so easily.
"Bang!"
Jiang Pingan crashed into a frozen building.
Seeing that this person's willpower was so unstable, Chu Meiyan immediately mobilized more soul power to charm him.
"Brother, come and help my sister deal with these bad guys. I will reward you well later."
"Chu Meiyan!
You are so brave, you dare to intercept us all by yourself. "
Su Jin's cold scolding sounded, and at the same time he fiddled with the strings in his hand and released sound waves to attack Chu Meiyan.
Chu Meiyan raised her hand and held out a purple-patterned magic lamp. Faint purple light spread out in all directions, and an invisible barrier blocked Su Jin's sonic offensive.
"Giggle."
Chu Meiyan's smile was full of temptation, making people's hearts beat wildly. "It's impossible to kill you, and I don't want to kill you, but I must stop you."
The purple light suddenly brightened, forming a purple barrier that enveloped everyone in Lingyan Temple.
The lamp in her hand is a high-level artifact that can not only defend but also release barriers.
